note: 此刻那一本主线节点原画的场面稿，第二轮之三：主城三幕主线 #1184 到 #1191 余下的十六幕。

nodes.name: 镜廊
who: the dark-haired night-folk lady in the crimson and black gown
nodes.light: cold silver light inside a row of tall mirrors on the right, against a dim red corridor, with a small clear glow from a vial in the huntress's hand
nodes.camera: at shoulder height in the gallery, close behind the two women, looking along the row of mirrors; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a long gallery of an old castle: a red carpet, dark panelling, and all down the right-hand wall a row of tall mirrors in black frames, each higher than a door. The mirrors do not show the gallery. In each one, lit by a cold silver light of its own, a scene is caught like a painting: a figure in evening dress bending over the neck of another who has gone limp in its arms. The figures in the mirrors are only dark shapes with no faces to be made out; in the nearest mirror the bending shape leans with one hand on a walking cane whose head is a rose wrought in iron. Out of two of the mirrors further down the gallery, copies of the two women themselves are beginning to step, grey and blank-eyed. In the foreground stand the two women, close together, both turned toward the nearest mirror. On the left, in full profile facing right, is a young huntress of twenty: glossy black hair in a high ponytail, a silver ring in her right ear, a short dark hunter's cloak over a buttoned long-sleeved jacket and trousers. Her silver crossbow hangs lowered in her right hand, pointing at the floor; her left hand holds up before her face a small glass vial in which a drop of silver dew shines, and by its light she is studying the cane in the mirror. Her face has lost its coldness and is troubled. On the right, seen directly from behind, stands the dark-haired night-folk lady in the crimson and black gown, short black hair with a blue sheen; her right hand is laid flat on the glass of the mirror and her left hand hangs at her side, clenched. Motes of silver light and dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：会复制人的镜廊照出几个俯身咬人的影子，有一个拄着铁蔷薇头的手杖，银露一枚一枚取回来，莉拉的弩口就低一分。影子不画脸，是谁不点破。

nodes.name: 花心
nodes.light: a deep crimson glow from the heart of the giant rose above, with thin red streams of light running up the briars into it, against a red-black night sky and cold silver on the crossbow
nodes.camera: low on a tower roof, close behind the huntress, looking steeply up at the rose that fills the sky; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night above an old castle of the night folk; the sky is a deep dull red with no stars. The roof of the great hall has been torn open from inside, and out of it has risen a rose as large as the castle itself: a queen made of a flower, her body a column of briars as thick as towers, her arms long sprays of thorn, and for a head and breast a single enormous dark-red bloom, opening. She fills the picture and is cut off by the frame at the top and on both sides. Up every briar, from the hall below, thin streams of red light are running like sap toward the bloom. In the open heart of the bloom, among the innermost petals, a small dark figure sits as on a throne: only a black outline, upright, both hands resting on something before it; nothing of its face or dress can be made out. Two lesser blooms hang lower on the column, one of them shattered and falling in petals. In the near foreground, on the slope of a tower roof, a young huntress stands seen directly from behind: glossy black hair in a high ponytail whipping to the left, a short dark hunter's cloak, tall boots braced on the slates. She holds a silver crossbow raised to her shoulder, aimed up at the heart of the bloom, her left hand under the stock and her right hand at the trigger. Beside her on the right, in full profile facing left and looking up, stands a slender young woman with short black hair with a blue sheen and a thin small braid at her cheek, in a dark coat, her right hand stretched out with a single drop of silver light hanging above the palm. Petals and red sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：血蔷薇化成蔷薇女王升进夜空，宾客的血顺着藤蔓往花心里流，花心里坐着一个人。那个人只画黑影，不点破。萨薇尔不拿立绘（参考图留给画风）。血月不写月字。

nodes.name: 点名
who: the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat
nodes.light: small cold blue-grey flames of ghostly campfires in rows, against the black of a vast crypt, with one warm point from the lantern the living knight carries
nodes.camera: low among the seated ghosts, close to the dead knight, looking along the rows toward the one who has stood up; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an underground hall as wide as a parade ground beneath a city of tombs: pillars of bone-coloured stone, and between them an encampment of the dead. In long straight rows, hundreds of soldiers sit round small campfires that burn cold blue-grey and give no warmth: figures in old-fashioned legion armour, half transparent, heads bowed, hands on their knees, most of them quite still, like men who have forgotten how to do anything else. In the foreground on the left, standing in full profile facing right toward the rows, is a dead woman knight who looks twenty-two: a face so white that the cheekbones show, pale flaxen hair tied low at the nape, old-fashioned legion plate with a bell engraved on the breastplate, her helmet under her left arm. Her right hand is raised to the height of her shoulder, open, like an officer calling a roll; her mouth is open, calling. Her head is tilted a little to one side to see. In the middle distance, among the seated rows, one soldier has stood up in answer: an old sergeant with a grey moustache, half transparent, his right fist pressed to his breastplate in salute, his head lifted and his eyes, for the first time, looking at something. Two others near him are raising their heads. Behind the dead knight on the far left, seen directly from behind, stands the golden-haired knight in the dark blue surcoat and steel plate, a long braid down her back, holding a lantern low in her left hand and in her right hand a long black iron nail with a ring at its head. Grey motes and cold sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：亡魂的驻地里，还留着神智的旧军士，艾尔莎先喊番号，应得上来的一个一个领回来。埃莉诺手里那一枚是镇魂钉。

nodes.name: 钟下
nodes.light: a cold pale glow from the great bell overhead and from the general's hollow armour, against a black night sky, with small grey flames far below in the city
nodes.camera: low on the floor of the bell chamber, a wide side view with the dead knight on the left and the general on the right under the bell; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in the open bell chamber at the top of a huge tower of bone-coloured stone, high above a city of tombs. Overhead hangs a bell as big as a house, cut off by the top of the frame, still humming with pale light. Through the arches on every side we see, far below, the streets of the city filled with ranks of pale soldiers standing in formation, waiting, and a stair crowded with more of them winding up the tower. On the right, under the bell, in full profile facing left, stands the general of the dead legion: a giant in ornate antique plate armour, three times the height of a person, his helm cast in the shape of a bell, nothing visible inside the armour but a cold glow. His left hand holds upright a tattered legion standard on a tall pole; his right hand is raised toward the rope of the bell. On the left, facing him in full profile facing right, stands a dead woman knight who looks twenty-two: a face so white that the cheekbones show, pale flaxen hair tied low at the nape, old-fashioned legion plate with a bell engraved on the breastplate, her helmet set down on the floor behind her. In her right hand she holds her drawn sword low, point toward the floor; in her left hand she holds up toward him, at arm's length, an old folded letter, soft with handling, its corners worn quite round. She stands at attention as she offers it; her face is steady. Three iron nails with ringed heads are driven into the stone floor between them, faintly glowing. Grey ash-like motes and pale sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：骨钟将军带兵登上钟楼，要领着军团重回人间，艾尔莎胸甲里那封信边角早已磨圆。信里写的什么不画。埃莉诺没进画。

nodes.name: 画前
who: the violet-haired mage in the black and white robe
nodes.light: a grey, shadowless light that comes out of the one painting she faces, against the dim violet of a long gallery, with small gilded glints on the frames
nodes.camera: at shoulder height a few steps behind the mage, looking past her at the tall painting; level and still
nodes.text: Scene: a long, silent gallery inside a dream: a floor of dark polished wood, violet walls, and along them a row of paintings in heavy gilded frames, each as tall as a door. The paintings we can see in passing are nightmares held still: one shows a schoolroom at the bottom of the sea, the desks in rows under green water; one shows a throne room hanging upside down; one shows a theatre stage with a single lit circle and rows of empty seats going back for ever. In the middle of the picture hangs the painting that matters: a wide grey landscape of a plain road that comes to a place where it parts into many roads, each running off to a different horizon, with a tall signpost at the parting whose boards are all blank; no one is on any of the roads. Before this painting, seen directly from behind, stands the violet-haired mage in the black and white robe: long straight violet hair down her back, the long black coat-robe with its white collar. She stands quite still with both arms at her sides, her staff held loosely in her right hand with its foot on the floor, her left hand a little open; her head is tilted back to look. Her reflection shows faintly in the varnish of the painting, standing alone at the parting of the roads. Several paces to her right, in full profile facing left and watching her, waits a young dream-demon woman with short violet-grey hair, three paintbrushes behind her ear and two very small dark horns, in a paint-stained smock, holding one long brush against her chest in both hands. Dust motes and flecks of gilt drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：海底教室、倒悬王宫、无尽舞台，每走进一幅都要对着自己最怕的东西。菲伦站在其中一幅前面很久没有说话。她怕的那一样画成一条分岔的路、路牌都是空的。

nodes.name: 彩墨
nodes.light: vivid running colours, crimson, cobalt, viridian and gold, glowing from the body of the dragon above, against white unpainted canvas and a pale sky
nodes.camera: low on the shifting ground, close behind the two women, looking up at the dragon coiled over the roofs; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a city that has become a painting still being made: its gabled houses and towers are drawn in wet ink and wash, the street is bare white canvas in places, and everything is slowly changing, a roof turning into a wave, a tower into a tree, as if a brush were passing over it. Over the roofs coils a dragon as long as the city, a heavy Western wyrm with bat-like wings, made entirely of running coloured ink: crimson, cobalt, viridian and gold streak and drip down its sides and fall as rain, and wherever the drops land the city changes again. It is cut off by the frame at the top and on both sides; its head hangs low toward us, jaws open. From windows all over the city, thin pale threads, the dreams of sleepers, are still being drawn up into its body. In the foreground two women stand on a patch of street that is only half painted. On the left, seen directly from behind, is the violet-haired mage: long straight violet hair, a mage's battle dress with long sleeves. She holds her staff levelled at the dragon with both hands on it, both arms visible, the right hand near the head of the staff and the left hand further back on the shaft, and in front of the staff the air is splitting like panes of glass, layer after layer of the false scene cracking open in a widening ring to show plain daylight behind. On the right, in full profile facing left, a young dream-demon woman of twenty, plainly a girl, with a soft round girlish face, large gentle ink-grey eyes with long lashes and a small mouth, short violet-grey hair curling in at her jaw, three brushes behind her ear and two very small dark horns, in a paint-stained painter's smock over a long plain skirt that falls past her knees (no trousers), kneels on one knee: with a long brush in her right hand she is painting, in one sure stroke of gold, the stretch of street under their feet, so that it holds; her left hand steadies a jar of ink. Drops of colour and torn flakes of canvas streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：食梦魔吞下全城的梦化成彩墨巨龙，脚下的画布一刻不停地变，菲伦破开幻层。米拉贝尔拿回了画笔，把脚下那一段街画住是我补的画面。

nodes.name: 黑帆
who: the grey-blue-haired wyvern rider in the long leather flight coat
nodes.light: white lightning inside towering grey-violet storm cloud on both sides, with a thin band of cold yellow evening light ahead between the clouds
nodes.camera: from just behind and above the stern of a small skiff, looking forward over the two people at the fleet ahead; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: evening in the high air, in a canyon between two walls of thundercloud that tower out of the picture; lightning runs inside them, and big rocks float in the gap between, some with dead trees on them. Through the gap ahead, against a thin band of yellow light, runs a fleet of seven air-pirate ships with black sails, wooden hulls hung under long gas-bags, ballista ports along their sides; from the stern of the largest hangs a cage of iron bars, and inside it glows half of a great blue crystal. We look forward from the stern of a small open air-skiff, a narrow boat with one triangular sail and a brass engine, heeled hard over to slip between two floating rocks. At the tiller in the stern, on the right, seen directly from behind, sits the grey-blue-haired wyvern rider in the long leather flight coat, steel-grey-blue hair tied at the nape and streaming, his right hand on the tiller and his left hand hauling a rope of the sail. In the bow, on the left, a small winged girl of sixteen kneels in full profile facing right toward the fleet: a pair of large deep teal wings held half open for balance, the tip of one notched by an old healed injury, wind-tangled hair, a padded long-sleeved jacket and trousers, a safety line clipped to her belt. Her left hand grips the gunwale; her right arm points straight ahead at the caged crystal. Her mouth is open, shouting back over her shoulder to him without turning her body. She is unhurt. Rain, torn cloud and sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：小空艇穿过雷云和浮石群追上黑帆舰队，那半颗鲸心在其中一艘船上。琪珀十六岁，照未成年画。被抓的驯鲸师没画。

nodes.name: 鲸背
who: the grey-blue-haired wyvern rider in the long leather flight coat
nodes.light: a hard blue glow from the crystal in the chest of the diving machine above, against a wide cold sky at dusk, with the last amber light along the whale's back
nodes.camera: low on the whale's back, close behind the rider, looking up at the machine that dives on us; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in the open sky above the clouds, on the back of a sky whale in flight: its slate-blue back stretches away before us as broad and long as a field, ridged, with a row of old mooring rings bolted along the spine and long fins like sails beating slowly on either side; a black stone tower with docking ports stands far off in the cloud. Diving on the whale out of the upper right, huge and close, cut off by the frame, comes a flying machine built in the shape of a wyvern: riveted iron plates, jointed wings of canvas and steel, smoke pouring from its neck, and set in its chest behind a grille a great blue crystal that blazes. In a glass-fronted seat behind its head we can just see the dark outline of a man in a captain's hat. Its iron claws are spread to strike. In the foreground, in the middle of the whale's back, the grey-blue-haired wyvern rider in the long leather flight coat stands seen directly from behind, braced with his feet wide, coat and hair streaming to the left; in both hands he holds a long lance levelled up at the crystal in the machine's chest. A line runs from his belt to one of the mooring rings. Far along the back behind him to the left, small and well clear, a small winged girl kneels beside the whale's blowhole with both palms laid flat on its skin and her teal wings folded tight; she is unhurt, and her head is bowed toward the whale. A long pale gash along the whale's side below shows a dim, failing blue light. Smoke, sparks and blown spray streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：黑帆的头领维尔讷把鲸心晶装进飞龙机甲，掉头扑向那头鲸，仗就打在它宽阔的背上。琪珀在远处，照未成年画，离机甲远。苍风的兵器立绘上是什么照立绘，这里写成长枪。

nodes.name: 雷符
who: the huge grey-skinned half-orc in dark plate
nodes.light: a small fierce blue-white glow from a stitched charm in the guard's hand, against the wet black iron of a prison yard, with cold storm light above and one tower crackling behind
nodes.camera: low in the yard, close behind the shoulder of an armoured officer, looking at the young guard who faces him; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a night of storm in a yard of a prison city built of black iron: tiers of open cell doors, catwalks, puddles on iron plates. Behind the yard rises one of the city's lightning towers, its top wrapped in crackling blue arcs, with small robed figures moving on its gallery. In the near foreground on the left, seen directly from behind and cut off at the shoulders, stands an officer of the city guard in heavy armour and a crested helm, a rolled order with a seal in his gauntleted right hand. Facing him, and facing us, in the middle of the picture, stands a young woman jail guard of twenty: a horned demon-kin woman with a pair of short bull-like horns, the left one worn shiny, a thick braid over her shoulder, a jailer's leather armour buttoned to the top, a large ring of keys at her hip. With her right hand she holds up between them, at the height of his eyes, a torn-off piece of grey prison jacket, and on its inside is stitched a round charm of metal thread that blazes blue-white; her left hand points down at a man who lies bound at her feet in a prisoner's grey clothes, his sleeve torn open, glaring. Her face is furious and exact. Behind her on the right, standing with his back to a huddled group of about twenty ordinary prisoners in grey, men and women, thin and frightened and unhurt, is the huge grey-skinned half-orc in dark plate, facing us, two heads taller than anyone, his arms spread a little to either side to keep them behind him. Rain and blue sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：托巴尔叫信徒换上囚衣混进犯人堆，身上缝着雷符，城防那道囚犯可牺牲的令就是这样逼出来的。拿下一个缝着雷符的，把雷符摊在城防跟前。

nodes.name: 控制钉
nodes.light: blue-white lightning crawling over the giant's back from the spikes in its spine, against black storm cloud that turns slowly round its head, with wet iron glinting below
nodes.camera: low on the top of the city wall, close behind two small figures, looking steeply up at the giant that is climbing over the wall; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a night of storm on the top of the outer wall of a prison city built of black iron. A storm giant is climbing onto the wall: a figure as tall as a mountain, grey-blue skinned, with a long beard of cloud and broken chains hanging from its wrists and neck; one of its hands has come down on the battlements and crushed them, and its head and shoulders rise against a sky where the storm cloud is turning in a slow wheel around it. It fills the picture and is cut off by the frame at the top and on both sides. Its face is turned down toward us, and its eyes are not the eyes of a weapon: they are wide, pained and aware, looking at the small people below as if asking something. On its right shoulder stands a tiny figure of an old troll in rags with welded fetters on both wrists, in full profile; his right hand holds a hammer raised above his head, and his left hand steadies a long iron spike whose point is set against the back of the giant's neck. Down the giant's spine below that, a row of such spikes has already been driven in, and from each of them lightning crawls out over its back and chains of light run up to the old troll's fetters. In the near foreground, on the wall top, two figures stand seen directly from behind: on the left a huge grey-skinned half-orc in dark plate with both fists closed, and on the right, reaching only to his chest, a young woman jail guard with short horns and a thick braid down her back, a ring of keys at her hip, her right arm raised and pointing up at the row of spikes. Rain, sparks and chips of iron streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：巨人登上城墙，托巴尔站在它肩上一根一根往它脊骨里敲控制钉，巨人的眼睛里好像还有它自己的意思。两个人只画背影，不拿立绘。

nodes.name: 看水
who: the tall sea-folk ship's doctor in the white surgeon's coat
nodes.light: a soft sea-green light filtering through walls of water on both sides, with a small warm pearl-coloured glow in the basin ahead and one lamp in the doctor's hand
nodes.camera: low in the corridor, close to the girl's outstretched hand, looking along the corridor to the basin; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a corridor in a temple at the bottom of the sea: a long hall of pale stone held dry inside a great bubble of air, so that its side walls are standing walls of green water with fish and drifting weed behind them, and the floor is wet. The stone walls between the pillars are covered with old carved and painted murals of kings, ships and sea serpents, faded. At the far end of the corridor a round basin is sunk in the floor, and in it the water turns in a slow whirlpool; in the eye of the whirlpool a pearl as big as a fist gives off a warm glow. Thin streams of water are running across the floor toward the basin, and the level in it is rising. In the foreground on the left, standing in full profile facing right, is a sea-folk girl of eighteen: hair cut below the ears with white salt at the tips, faint gill lines on the side of her neck, a fisher's long-sleeved smock and rolled trousers, bare feet in the running water, a bundle wrapped in fishing net on her back with a dull coral-red glow inside it. She has turned her back on the murals. Her right arm is stretched out with the hand held low and open in one of the streams of water, feeling which way it pulls; her left hand is raised with one finger pointing along the stream toward the basin. Her eyes follow the water, sure and absorbed. Behind her on the far left, facing us and looking up at a mural, stands the tall sea-folk ship's doctor in the white surgeon's coat, short messy blue-black hair with a small star ornament, a brass lamp held up in her right hand and her left hand on her hip. Drops of water and green glints drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：气泡回廊、漩涡圣池，珊蒂不看壁画，只看水往哪儿流，潮珠一颗一颗找齐。水往上涌是泰隆德在往外推封印。

nodes.name: 叠城
who: the tall sea-folk ship's doctor in the white surgeon's coat
nodes.light: a cold green-white glow rising out of the sea from a drowned city under the surface, against a black night sky, with warm lamps along the fortress wall behind us
nodes.camera: low on the wall-walk of the fortress, close behind the girl and the doctor, looking out and up at the serpent and its rider; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on the sea wall of a dark blue coastal fortress. Out of the sea before the wall a serpent is rising: a deep-sea snake as thick as a lighthouse, black-green and scaled, its neck arching up out of the water and cut off by the top of the frame, water pouring from it. On its head, between two fins, stands a drowned king, small against the sky, in full profile facing left toward the wall: a tall figure in rusted, barnacled royal armour and the rags of a mantle, long pale hair streaming with water, his bare head held high. His right hand is stretched out toward the wall, open and commanding, asking for what is his; his left hand holds a trident. Behind and below him the whole surface of the sea is lit from underneath with cold green-white light, and in that light the shape of a drowned city has risen just under the waves: roofs, a bell tower, a city gate, lying exactly over the real harbour so that sunken streets run on from the real quays. In the near foreground on the wall-walk two figures stand. On the right, seen directly from behind, a sea-folk girl with hair cut below the ears and bare feet has taken a bundle wrapped in fishing net off her back and holds it against her chest with both arms; through the net a crown of red coral shines. On the left, in full profile facing right, stands the tall sea-folk ship's doctor in the white surgeon's coat, her left arm held across in front of the girl and her right hand gripping a boat hook like a spear. Spray and green sparks streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：溺冠王泰隆德骑着深海巨蛇升向蓝堡，身后浮起整座沉城的影子，跟蓝堡的码头叠在一处。他要在城头把冠戴回去。

nodes.name: 钻出来
who: the young saintess in white robes with a thin gold circlet
nodes.light: a soft green-white healing glow from the small healer's hands in the middle, against the blue dark of a stone stair, with pale glints of eyes in the dark beyond
nodes.camera: low on the steps, close to the kneeling healer and the instructor, looking up the stair past them at the students; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a wide stone stair in an underground training labyrinth of an adventurers' academy: neat walls with numbered-looking but unreadable brass plates, practice dummies knocked over, a chalk line across a landing. Something has gone wrong: at the top of the stair, in the dark of an archway, the eyes of real monsters glint, a dozen pairs, and the shapes of claws show at the edge of the light. On the steps in the middle an instructor of the academy, a grown man of forty in a teacher's long coat, sits slumped against the wall, facing us, conscious, grimacing, his right hand clamped round his left upper arm where the sleeve is torn; there is no blood. Kneeling beside him, in full profile facing left toward him, is a small healer girl of about eighteen in an academy uniform with a long coat, the cuffs rolled twice: her hair is tied back so tight that it pulls at her temples, a bandage pouch with three compartments hangs at her belt, and a healing staff taller than herself lies across the steps where she has dropped it. Both her hands are held just above his arm and glow soft green-white. Her face is white with fright and completely steady. She is unhurt. Above them on the stair, facing up toward the archway with their backs to us, stand four other students in the same uniform holding blunt training swords and a practice shield, unhurt, crowded shoulder to shoulder. Among them, one step higher, in full profile facing right toward the dark, stands the young saintess in white robes with a thin gold circlet, soft golden hair past her shoulders, her staff raised in her right hand with its head burning white and her left hand spread out before the students. Motes of green light and stone dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕阶段①：冲上来的是真的魔物，受伤的导师倒在台阶上，胆小的艾米看见有人挂了彩，从人后钻了出来。学生照未成年画，不带伤；导师是成年人，只写袖子破了，不画血。

nodes.name: 后背
nodes.light: a bright warm gold glow from a badge floating overhead, against the cool blue-grey of a great mechanical hall, with glints on turning brass
nodes.camera: low on the edge of a moving platform, close to the two students, looking up at the badge and the machinery above; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a vast hall inside a training tower, built as an arena of mechanisms: square stone platforms rise and sink on brass pistons over a dark drop, great toothed wheels turn in the walls, padded pendulums swing across, and wooden target-figures on rails slide in and out of hatches. High in the middle of the hall, turning slowly in the air, floats a graduation badge, a star-shaped medal of gold on a ribbon, shining. On the nearest platform, which is just rising, two students of about eighteen stand back to back, both in the academy uniform with a long coat, both unhurt. The one on the left faces us: a tall proud-looking boy with fair hair combed back, a blunt training sword held up in a guard in both hands, his jaw tight, his eyes on a pendulum swinging toward him. The one on the right is seen directly from behind, pressed shoulder blade to shoulder blade against him: a stocky girl with short dark-red hair, a round practice shield raised on her left arm against a target-figure sliding out at her, a short blunt mace in her right hand. Neither looks round at the other. On the next platform to the left, a little lower and further off, three more students in the same uniform kneel at its edge, and the smallest of them, a girl with her hair tied back very tight, holds out toward the pair, with both arms, the end of a long healing staff for them to step across on. Flecks of gold light and chips of chalk drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：机关竞技场里找毕业徽章，原本互相较劲的学生到这里得把后背交给彼此。两个学生的样子是补的。照未成年画，不带伤。菲奥娜没进画。

nodes.name: 塔顶守卫
who: the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat
nodes.light: a hard cold blue-white glare from a knight of ice in the middle, against a night sky lit in the distance by five other towers, each pouring out a different colour
nodes.camera: from the head of the stair onto the tower top, low, close behind the two women, looking across the platform at the guardian and out over the city; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on the open top of a tall slender tower in a ring-shaped city. The platform is sheathed in ice: icicles hang upward from its rail, frost flowers cover the floor. In the middle, over a pedestal that holds a core crystal frozen inside a block of clear ice, stands the tower's guardian: a knight three times the height of a person, made entirely of blue-white ice, with a long cloak of falling snow and a great sword of ice whose point rests on the floor between its feet; cold pours off it in a visible mist. It faces us and has just lifted its head. Beyond the rail, across the dark city, five other towers stand in a wide ring, and from the top of each a different light is streaming into the sky: a column of water, a funnel of wind, a fork of lightning, a crown of floating rock, a great green tree of vines; one further tower, already taken, burns with a steady small red flame. In the near foreground at the head of the stair two women stand seen directly from behind. On the left is the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat, long straight crimson hair; her right arm is raised with a ball of amber-white fire gathering above the palm. On the right, a head shorter, is a woman technician with short deep-blue hair with one lock scorched white, overalls with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a ring of keys on a cord at her neck; her left hand holds up a long brass tuning rod toward the frozen core, and her right hand holds two glowing keys, one red and one sea-blue. Ice splinters and sparks of fire streak large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕阶段②：水、风、雷、岩、草、冰六座塔照自己挑的次序去攻，每座塔顶守着一个精英元素。画的是冰塔，远处别的五座各出各的光，已经拿下的火塔安稳了。

nodes.name: 摊开回路
who: the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat
nodes.light: seven colours of light shining from the body of the waking queen on the right, with a clear gold-white glow from the great diagram unfolding out of the mage's hands, against the dark of a reactor hall
nodes.camera: a wide side view from low on the floor of the hall, the mage on the left and the queen on the right, looking up so that the queen is cut off by the frame; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the central reactor hall of a city of mages: a round chamber as high as a cathedral, ringed with brass conduits and seven great sockets in which seven keys now burn. Its inner doors stand open. On the right half of the picture, rising out of the reactor well and cut off by the top of the frame, is the queen of the elements, just waking: a woman-shaped figure five times the height of a person, her body made in bands of the seven elements, flame, running water, wind, lightning, stone, living green and ice, her hair a drifting crown of all of them. She is in full profile facing left, and her eyes have just opened: two calm white lights, looking down. On the left half, on the floor before her, in full profile facing right, stands the crimson-haired mage in the black battle coat: long straight crimson hair, amber-gold eyes. Both her arms are held out before her with the hands open and turned up, and from between her hands a great diagram of gold-white light is unfolding into the air between her and the queen, spreading as wide as the hall: rings within rings, branching lines and small nodes like a map of rivers, intricate and complete, with no letters or numbers in it. Her hands are trembling and her face is bare, frightened and resolved, like someone showing a thing she has never shown anyone. Behind her on the far left, small, facing us, a woman technician with short deep-blue hair stands with a group of city mages in robes, all staring at the diagram; one of them has taken off his spectacles. Motes of seven colours drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕阶段③：钥匙齐了，中央反应炉的门开了，元素女王睁开眼睛，艾莉娅手在抖，把那套从没给人看过的回路摊开在所有人面前。缔约还是斩断没画。
